svg.text: Unpowered, 18 m/s = 65 km/h = 40 mph on a closed lot; film the prop; the driver only drives.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Repeat with the prop set along the flow and across it: the literature puts the difference at 25 to 30 %.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pass: no windmilling; the prop parks within 30° of the airflow; drag 0.8 N or less (model 0.44 N).
